## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you are proposing.

## 💡 Motivation & Problem Statement
Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve for students or admins?

## 🎨 Proposed Design / UI Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working. Include mockups, wireframes, or reference UI examples if applicable.

## 🛠️ Tech Stack & Implementation Considerations
Any technical details, APIs, or database schema changes needed.

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, links, or visual inspiration.
